It did not approve or execute a modern-wire projection. This finite assessment derives that wire representation from the explicit source Organization and already reviewed institutional attribution; it does not retrofit a type into the source profile.
existing_reviewed_semantic_rationale.profile_interpretation_verbatim: Each exact primary-citation institutional name is one literal attribution, including the hierarchical clauses separated by commas. Preserve the existing full creator object without expansion, splitting, contact promotion, inferred identifiers or affiliations. Existing full creator objects are preserved, including existing Organization types only for the NOAA and First Institute groups. No type is added to PICES or SOA.
